Practical support for real student life.

Programs & Services

From campaigns and screenings to anonymous help pathways and digital media, MINDWAVE turns mental health awareness into action students can use.

Objectives

A complete mental wellness layer for campus life.

Programs are designed as connected pathways: awareness, early support, screening, referral, storytelling, and long-term institutional learning.

Sustainable interventions

Design repeatable programs that can outlast a single student cohort.

Professional connection

Link students to qualified mental health professionals when care needs grow.

Peer safe spaces

Train and support peer advocates without turning them into clinicians.

Mental health literacy

Make accurate, non-judgmental mental health knowledge easy to access.

Screening pathways

Use consent, privacy, and clinical oversight for wellbeing checks.

Healthy coping

Promote practical, culturally grounded habits for resilience and recovery.

Services

Programs students can recognize, trust, and use.

Mental Health Literacy Campaigns

Campus-wide education that translates complex mental health concepts into clear, compassionate, student-friendly language.

  • Stigma reduction
  • Early recognition
  • Peer-to-peer education

KUHeS Chat Point

A calm point of entry for students who want to talk, ask questions, or be guided toward the right support pathway.

  • Low-pressure conversations
  • Referral guidance
  • Belonging

Anonymous Support Systems

Privacy-first request channels that help students reach out before distress becomes a crisis.

  • Confidential intake
  • Triage workflows
  • Trusted escalation

Mental Health Screenings

Structured wellbeing checks delivered with clinical guidance, clear consent, and careful follow-up.

  • Early support
  • Data-informed planning
  • Professional referrals

Storytelling Platforms

Anonymized stories, reflection prompts, and student voices that normalize honest conversations about mental wellbeing.

  • Reduced isolation
  • Community voice
  • Hopeful recovery narratives

Podcasts & Educational Media

Youth-centered audio, video, and social content with clinicians, students, and wellness advocates.

  • Accessible learning
  • Campus reach
  • Credible expert voices
